The '''senator''' of the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] was a [[spice lord]] from [[Sevarcos II]]. He traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when his [[Unidentified Tamarin sector senator's wife|wife]] wanted to see the opera their.<ref name="TEGTW AC 6" />
